title: Exploring the mechanism of oxfendazole in inhibiting osteosarcoma-induced osteolysis based on single-cell RNA seqsuencing.
authors: Miao, Jifeng; Wang, Pintian; Feng, Wenyu; Quan, Haiyi; Lin, Yunhua; Wei, Gejin; Meng, Fake; Li, Shanhang; Yang, Mingxiu; Ning, Binyuan; Deng, Jingxin; Xiong, Liang; Hu, Jianming; Liu, Yun; Wei, Qingjun
one_liner_zh: 该文通过单细胞测序和分子动力学模拟研究奥芬达唑抑制骨肉瘤溶骨作用，涉及ZNF530转录因子与DNA互作，但核心是药物筛选与溶骨机制，非TF-DNA结合建模主体系。
abstract: Osteosarcoma-associated osteolysis represents a major obstacle in the management of osteosarcoma. Within the osteolytic microenvironment, interactions between osteoclasts and tumor cells facilitate tumor proliferation and metastatic dissemination, and contribute to the development of pathological fractures. However, conventional osteoclast-targeting agents are insufficient to effectively suppress osteosarcoma-driven bone resorption. In this study, single-cell RNA sequencing was performed to identify critical regulators involved in osteoclast differentiation in the context of osteosarcoma. Using the Beyondcell platform, drugs targeting osteoclast-related signaling pathways were screened, and oxfendazole (OFN) was identified as a potential therapeutic candidate, with ANXA2 recognized as a key associated target. In vitro osteoclastogenesis assays and an in vivo tibial orthotopic osteosarcoma model demonstrated that oral administration of OFN via gavage effectively suppressed osteoclast formation and osteolytic activity, as confirmed by micro-CT and histopathological analyses. But OFN alone did not significantly inhibit osteosarcoma growth but effectively reduced osteoclast-mediated osteolysis. In addition, qRT-PCR and immunohistochemistry confirmed that OFN downregulates ANXA2 expression in vitro and in vivo, thereby impairing osteoclast differentiation. Molecular dynamics simulations combined with in-vitro validation further suggested that OFN may interact with the transcription factor ZNF530, leading to reduced ANXA2 transcription. In conclusion, the integration of single-cell RNA sequencing with the Beyondcell algorithm enabled the identification of OFN as a potent candidate agent for osteosarcoma-induced osteolysis. OFN attenuates osteoclastogenesis and bone resorption by suppressing ANXA2 expression. These findings provide preclinical evidence supporting the therapeutic potential of OFN in the treatment of osteosarcoma-associated osteolysis.
abstract_zh: 骨肉瘤相关的溶骨性病变是骨肉瘤治疗中的主要障碍。在溶骨性微环境中，破骨细胞与肿瘤细胞之间的相互作用促进了肿瘤增殖和转移扩散，并导致病理性骨折的发生。然而，传统的靶向破骨细胞的药物不足以有效抑制骨肉瘤驱动的骨吸收。本研究采用单细胞RNA测序（single-cell RNA sequencing）以识别骨肉瘤背景下参与破骨细胞分化的关键调控因子。利用Beyondcell平台筛选靶向破骨细胞相关信号通路的药物，并鉴定出奥芬达唑（oxfendazole, OFN）作为潜在的治疗候选药物，其中ANXA2被确认为关键的相关靶点。体外破骨细胞生成实验和体内胫骨原位骨肉瘤模型表明，通过灌胃口服OFN可有效抑制破骨细胞形成和溶骨活性，这一点通过micro-CT和组织病理学分析得到证实。但OFN单独使用并未显著抑制骨肉瘤生长，却有效减少了破骨细胞介导的溶骨作用。此外，qRT-PCR和免疫组织化学证实，OFN在体外和体内均下调ANXA2表达，从而损害破骨细胞分化。分子动力学模拟结合体外验证进一步提示，OFN可能与转录因子ZNF530相互作用，导致ANXA2转录减少。总之，将单细胞RNA测序与Beyondcell算法相结合，鉴定出OFN作为骨肉瘤诱导溶骨的有效候选药物。OFN通过抑制ANXA2表达来减弱破骨细胞生成和骨吸收。这些发现为OFN在治疗骨肉瘤相关溶骨中的治疗潜力提供了临床前证据。
